Title: Audit logging on Azure Database for PostgreSQL is now in preview

Body.Content:
Audit logging on Azure Database for PostgreSQL via PGAudit is now available in preview. Produce audit logs of events including writes, reads, role changes, and DDL with the PostgreSQL audit extension. Logs can be saved to a storage account, sent to Event Hub, or queried in Azure Monitor Logs.

Learn more
